configurations.name: nanashi
runtimeArgs: set -e; export PATH=$HOME/.local/share/mise/shims:$PATH; DSN=postgresql://postgres@127.0.0.1:55432/nanashi; (cd tessera && .venv/bin/python -m sparse_engine.pg_journal migrate "$DSN"); trap 'kill 0' EXIT; mkdir -p .nanashi-data; (cd router && go run ./cmd/nanashi-router --pg "$DSN" --listen 127.0.0.1:8090 --tessera ../tessera --engine-dir ../.nanashi-data) & (cd api && go run ./cmd/nanashi-api --pg "$DSN" --router http://127.0.0.1:8090) & (cd web && node_modules/.bin/vp dev --host 127.0.0.1) & wait
